description: Cross sections in pb at sqrt(s) = 13 TeV for the HSCP signals. Not read by the scripts. "theory": NLO+NLL / NNLO+NNLL predictions from https://github.com/fuenfundachtzig/xsec (one entry per original json file, keyed by mass in GeV). "run2_samples": cross sections used for the Run 2 HSCP signal samples (former xSec.dat; entries commented out there are not kept), keyed by mass in GeV; "dataset" gives the sample name.

pp13_gluino_NNLO+NNLL.comment: Gluino-gluino production cross sections with squarks decoupled. Provided by authors of NNLL-fast (arXiv:1607.07741).

pp13_stopsbottom_NNLO+NNLL.comment: stop and sbottom production cross sections with squarks and gluinos decoupled, decoupled regime, provided by Anna Kulesza and Christoph Borschensky, obtained using NNLL-fast, general set-up of calculations as described in arXiv:1607.07741, uncertainties on theory predictions symmetrized

pp13_stau_L_NLO+NLL.comment: stau-pair cross sections (partners of left-handed tau leptons), same as for other sleptons

pp13_stau_R_NLO+NLL.comment: stau-pair cross sections (partners of right-handed tau leptons), same as for other sleptons

pp13_stau_L_NLO+NLL_PDF4LHC.comment: Stau-pair cross sections (partners of left-handed tau leptons), same as for other sleptons. Calculated using Resummino at NLO+NLL and the PDF4LHC15 PDF set. Uncertainties are computed at 68 % C.L. using eq. 24 from https://arxiv.org/pdf/1510.03865.pdf.

pp13_stau_R_NLO+NLL_PDF4LHC.comment: Stau-pair cross sections (partners of right-handed tau leptons), same as for other sleptons. Calculated using Resummino at NLO+NLL and the PDF4LHC15 PDF set. Uncertainties are computed at 68 % C.L. using eq. 24 from https://arxiv.org/pdf/1510.03865.pdf.

pp13_stau_LR_NLO+NLL_PDF4LHC.comment: Stau-pair cross sections (sum of partners of left- and right-handed tau leptons), same as for other sleptons. Calculated using Resummino at NLO+NLL and the PDF4LHC15 PDF set. Uncertainties are computed at 68 % C.L. using eq. 24 from https://arxiv.org/pdf/1510.03865.pdf.

HSCPgluino.comment: https://twiki.cern.ch/twiki/bin/view/LHCPhysics/SUSYCrossSections13TeVgluglu: NLO+NLL below 500 GeV, NNLO+NNLL from 500 GeV.
